games.title: Lords of Waterdeep
games.blurb: A 3D clone of the Dungeons & Dragons worker-placement boardgame. Play against three CPU opponents and choose each one's skill level (Okay, Average or Good) at the start of a game.
games.note: Give it a moment to load the first time, as the card art takes a while to download.

games.title: Monopoly
games.blurb: A 3D Monopoly board, UK edition, with physical dice, CPU opponents, trading, auctions and save/load.
